findings.title: Release native Grok Other answers rejected for missing notes
findings.body: Selecting Other and accepting before notes passes the editor because the notes property is not required (src/acp/grok.rs:122-123) and values() only calls validate_form_values (src/tui/agent.rs:1648) before capture. Commit then fails at src/acp/grok.rs:161-164, correctly sending no wire response and leaving the question pending, but the native consumer does not recover: submit returns after enqueue, and the later DaemonError handler (src/tui/control.rs:421-428) never calls restore_unqueued. editable() then refuses both a corrected accept and F7 cancel while captured is set and the same revision stays pending (src/tui/agent.rs:1294-1296). API callers can retry with a new call id; the attached grant cannot. Enforce the Other-notes rule inside validate_form_values, which the editor already runs before capture, and clear captured when an acp-answer DaemonError leaves that interaction pending.
findings.consumer_impact: The same native grant cannot correct or cancel a still-pending Grok question after an empty Other answer.
